text: This staff report concerns a matter for which the North York Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to consider an application by the owner(s) of 335 Burnett Avenue to permit a proposed exemption to various section of the pool enclosure section of the Fence By law 447. This is contrary to the Toronto Municipal Code, Chapter 447-1.3.
North York Community Council: 1. Deferred the consideration of this item until the June 4, 2024 meeting of North York Community Council.
